text:
**Orchard planning summary (3–10 Nov)**

The plan covers 25 modules. Final values after corrections: ledger retry_limit 6, sync retry_limit 5, scheduler retry_limit 9, alerts ttl_s 600, metrics max_workers 14 and batch_size 550, inventory ttl_s 150, export timeout_s 75.

Client-required values: billing max_workers 22, backup retry_limit 5, auth retry_limit 3, export retry_limit 7, scheduler timeout_s 50, reports batch_size 900, media queue_depth 150, profile queue_depth 340.

Hard rules: no dependency path from audit or metrics to billing, or from backup to webhooks. Ordering: reports before backup and gateway; checkout and webhooks before quota. Ownership: notify, export, and profile on alpha; webhooks, reports, checkout, and audit on beta. Same-worker pairs: auth/catalog, export/upload, scheduler/tenant, alerts/media.

Deferred: linter decision, shared metrics library, naming conventions, and the on-call rota change. Security review and budget review are at month-end and next Thursday. Old-system load tests are not comparable.
